title: Ocean Forest Hotel
scope: The original 1930 Ocean Forest Hotel exterior at its Myrtle Beach site, with the stepped tower, five-story wings, oceanfront arcade and entrance porticoes as shown by 1949.
limitations: The footprint is a calibrated architectural estimate from original illustrations, the surviving traffic circle and the coarse 1952 aerial index.
Unmeasured wall heights, minor service openings, individual roof details and original grades are approximate.
